target_customer: Crypto users on Algorand who lend, borrow and earn yield, and ALGO holders
problem: Algorand lacked a native lending market and stablecoin. Algofi built a decentralized lending protocol, a native stablecoin and liquidity incentives, aiming to become a crypto native bank bridging centralized and decentralized finance.
business_model: DeFi protocol earning interest rate spreads and fees, with a later governance token

founders.name: John Clarke
founders.background_notes: Worked on Citadel's fixed income team before founding Algofi per FF News and AlleyWatch.

founders.name: Owen Colegrove
founders.background_notes: Citadel fixed income team per FF News; physics PhD, institution not named, per AlleyWatch.

exit.reason: The team said a confluence of events meant the protocol could no longer be maintained to its highest standard; CoinDesk tied this to the fall in ALGO's price and the SEC labelling Algorand a security.

technical_complexity.rationale: Smart contracts holding user funds, collateral and liquidation logic and a native stablecoin must be secure on a new chain with less tooling than Ethereum.

defensibility.rationale: DeFi code is public and forkable. Early liquidity on Algorand gave a temporary advantage, as Algofi held over half of Algorand's TVL in 2023.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Established Ethereum lenders did not target Algorand; the risk came from chain level adoption and later Algorand rivals such as Folks Finance.

market_need_then: DeFi lending grew rapidly in 2021 and Algorand had a DEX and bridging but no lending market, which the company launched on mainnet in December 2021.

identity.voice_and_tone: Mission language about democratizing finance and a crypto native bank

branding.brand_signature: Positioned as the largest DeFi hub on Algorand
branding.community_and_virality: A Discord community remained open after other social accounts closed at shutdown, per search coverage.

brand_strength.rationale: Name tied to the Algorand ecosystem and broad crypto press at funding and shutdown, with the protocol reaching a peak TVL of about US$135M by one report; the name depended on a single chain.

outcome_analysis: Algofi, founded by two Citadel fixed income alumni in YC Summer 2021, raised a US$2.8M seed led by Union Square Ventures, Arrington XRP Capital and Pillar, launched on Algorand mainnet in December 2021 and became the chain's largest DeFi protocol. On July 11, 2023 it announced a wind down after a drop in ALGO's price and the SEC calling Algorand a security shrank DeFi activity on the chain.
notes: Seed is stated by AlleyWatch, Finextra (November 30, 2021) and Pillar; the lead split differs across outlets and Seedtable lists conflicting leads. No later rounds were found, but a BANK governance token launched in October 2022 per search results. The algofi.org site did not resolve from this environment, so the website was not fetched. The competition list is empty because the pages opened name no rivals and the only dated Algorand rival evidence found (Tinyman as a DEX, Folks Finance launching in 2022) is a different category or postdates the batch. Founders confirmed by FF News (August 27, 2021); YC page lists none.
